items.title: Joe Mazzulla says Payton Pritchard’s journey, from being out of the Celtics’ rotation earlier in his career to what he has done since then, is a great lesson to learn from:
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Joe Mazzulla says Payton Pritchard’s journey, from being out of the Celtics’ rotation earlier in his career to what he has done since then, is a great lesson to learn from:

“He just maintained to your point, a level of toughness, a level of resilience, but I think a level of open-mindedness.”

quote.author: Bobby Krivitsky
quote.text:
On the heels of his contract extension, Payton Pritchard reflects on going from being out of Celtics’ rotation to everything he has accomplished since:

“You go through so many ups and downs, you’ve just gotta keep going, keep getting better every day. You just don’t know how far you can take it.”

items.title: Payton Pritchard on what he loves about playing in Boston:

Payton Pritchard on what he loves about playing in Boston:

“I think it's what Boston represents. You go for championships. They hold you to a high standard. The media holds you to a high standard, organization too, and I appreciate being in an environment like that.”

quote.author: Bobby Krivitsky
quote.text:
Payton Pritchard on his contract extension with the Celtics:

“I love it here. I love competing for the city (and) competing for the organization.”

The Celtics have officially announced Payton Pritchard's contract extension.

The $21.2M he signed for in 2028-29 is the maximum he was eligible for.

Then, he becomes extension eligible in October of 2028, a year in advance of the $22.9M mutual option for the 2029-2030 season.
